environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB forwards all HTTP traffic to the target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to EC2 on 8080. No additional request inspection or filtering rules configured on the ALB listener. CloudWatch logging enabled for access logs only.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules (forward all to target group)
